name: Occlura
tagline: The operating layer for the modern independent dental practice.
positioning: Occlura unifies scheduling, patient recall, and claims into one operations console built for owner-operators and small dental teams.

hero.h1: Run your practice on one operations console.
hero.sub: Occlura replaces the tangle of scheduling spreadsheets, recall reminders, and claims portals with a single system built for independent dental owner-operators.

features.title: Recall that never lapses
features.description: Automated six-month recall sequences pull from your chart notes and re-book overdue hygiene patients before the chair sits empty.

features.title: Claims without the portal maze
features.description: Submit, track, and reconcile insurance claims across payers from one queue — with denial reasons decoded in plain language.

features.title: Chair-time analytics
features.description: See production per operatory, no-show rates, and provider utilization on a single dashboard updated after every appointment.

features.title: Smart schedule fills
features.description: When a patient cancels, Occlura offers the slot to your waitlist and confirms the swap by text in seconds.

features.title: HIPAA-grade by default
features.description: Encrypted patient records, audit logs, and role-based access come standard — no add-on, no separate compliance vendor.

features.title: Front-desk automations
features.description: Intake forms, insurance verification, and balance reminders run on their own so your team stops chasing paperwork.

testimonials.quote: We cut our monthly no-show rate from 18% to under 6% in one quarter. Occlura's waitlist fills the chair before I even notice the gap.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marissa Cardenas

testimonials.quote: Claims used to eat two afternoons a week. Now denials come back tagged with a reason and a fix. My office manager got her time back.
testimonials.name: Dr. Anthony Weller

testimonials.quote: I run a two-operatory office without an office administrator. Occlura is effectively my operations team. The recall engine alone paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Raman
